QuestInfo.name: Sign of the Resurrection
QuestInfo.0: Could what Shammos said have come to pass?
QuestInfo.1: You got a message from El Nath stating that something strange is going on with the Hoblins. Go to Shammos and find out what's going on.
QuestInfo.2: Shammos says that the resurrection of Rex the Hoblin King is imminent.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 14,050\nCan proceed to the 'Robeira's Proposal' quest\n

0.0: I've received reports of strange Hoblin movement recently. They've been spotted near the Ice Gorge. And I'm worried about the way Shammos has been acting... He was actually able to communicate with Rex.\r\nHmm, Shammos may know something. Go find out whatever you can.

yes.0: Please hurry before the situation gets worse.

no.0: Are you going to just sit back and watch what happens?

1.0: I knew you would come to me. As I've been trying to tell you, Rex has returned!\r\n#L0##bRex... the Hoblin King?#l\n#k
1.1: Yes, Rex the Hoblin King! Stupid Robeira. She should have heeded my warning. Now his resurrection is at hand. He must be stopped!

yes.0: If he isn't stopped, everyone will be in danger. Even... a Hoblin like myself. Something must be done...
